replies.author: Shadowbladz
replies.body:
An axe + water = rip your defence. 
Plus against any team with a good offensive player you'll never have enough time to set this up.

Overly complicated with no real easy way for the defenders to assess the monument.

-1

replies.author: goldenwalrus909
replies.body:
To rebuttal Shadow's comment, axes and water can destroy any defense. Of course you can't make this in any game.. he just made it and was very proud of his work, so he decided to share it. Also, if defenders have a hard time accessing the monument, rushers do, too.. And if a rusher kills all of the defenders at the monument, (s)he deserves to win.. xD
Really, the only thing I see wrong with this is that you can go around the wall horizontally. If you expanded it a bit, it would be way harder to get around. Amazing job, though :3

replies.body:
This has been said before, a ton but ezpz. Because of the giant wool, you don't even need a massive skybridge, only a small one from the wall to the monument.
Pillar up behind the wall, if you see the offender, he can ez shoot you out as there are no walls arround the monument and its a small area to stand on, then bridge to the monument from the wall and you wont be able to come back and shoot me considering how far away spawn is. if for somereason the offender is deadly slow you have to get past your own deffence or shoot at an awkward angle.
